stem: Which graphic organizer best compares the energy inputs and outputs of cellular respiration and photosynthesis?

options.label: A
options.text: Chemical energy → Cellular respiration → Thermal energy → Photosynthesis → Light energy

options.label: B
options.text: Light energy → Photosynthesis → Chemical energy → Cellular respiration → Chemical energy

options.label: C
options.text: Chemical energy → Photosynthesis → Thermal energy → Cellular respiration → Chemical energy

options.label: D
options.text: Light energy → Cellular respiration → Chemical energy → Photosynthesis → Thermal energy

visual_elements: Four flowchart diagrams labeled A, B, C, and D each showing different energy inputs and outputs for cellular respiration and photosynthesis processes.
